featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area
 ![](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif)
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Ghost Hunters**
* All standard Arcade server rules apply unless stated below. Rules marked with an asterisk on the Official [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) do not apply.
* Free roaming is prohibited outside the [playable area](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif).
* Participants must remain inside the map boundaries, as per §2.5 - Reckless Driving.
* Participants are permitted to drive any vehicle including a truck, bus, car, or AI vehicle.
* Participants should park in any company yard in a city listed on the "playable area" map before the start of the event. 
* Participants are prohibited from leaving the starting cities until an Event Manager has announced the event has begun.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Participants**  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Tirana.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.  

**Event Rules for Event Staff**  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

today.description:
## CZECHOSLOVAK INDEPENDENCE DAY CONVOY!
- Konvoj ke Dni vzniku československého státu.
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/R36hFdZ.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is not limited for this convoy - use curtainside trailer. 
7. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **19:30**  - Meetup at slots in Košice.
*  **20:00** -  Departure from the Košice in direction B. Bystrica.
*  **20:15** -  Passage around the city B.Bystrica.
*  **20:25**  - Passage around the Poland border.
*  **20:40**  - Passage trough the Ostrava city.
*  **20:45**  - Meetup in Bratislava for players who joins later.
*  **20:50**  - Pause on the highway near Bratislava (connection of late joined).
*  **21:00** -  Departure from the pause near Bratislava!
*  **21:10** -  Passage around the city of Brno.
*  **21:30** -  Arrival to the Prague - end of the event.

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/FgguxVn.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

* **1. Košice, BCP - Prague, Stein Bruch.**
* **2. Bratislava, BCP - Prague, Stein Bruch.**

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## 万圣节狩猎

今年，一些可恶的Haulie逃到了德国地区，并将它们藏在没人能找到的地方。现在，我们需要您来帮助我们，以免为时已晚！

我们需要您的帮助，在 10 月 31 日 20:30 和 23:00 期间前来，并尝试找到所有的Haulie！

你会接受挑战并在逃脱之前寻找丢失的Haulie吗？加入狩猎，让我们把Haulie带回它们所属的地方。

根据一些线索，我们已经知道了Haulie所在的大致区域，它们都还在那里！有**8个**Haulie可供发现：紫色、绿色、蓝色、黄色、橙色和红色Haulie，以及**2个**滚动的Haulie。

活动将于 10 月 31 日 20:30 开始，您必须在23:00找到所有Haulie！

**无需任何DLC！**



-----



## 怎么玩？

**8个**Haulie被困在我们给出的区域中，如果您是最快找到所有Haulie的人，您将获得由**Super CC**提供的特别奖品！

所有Haulie都将由我们的活动团队员工代表，他们的前缀与他们所托运的Haulie相匹配，如：“SE|Rolling Haulie” （此前缀中文翻译："SE|滚动的Haulie“）

***请注意，在参与本次活动时，不要使用任何TPC工具，这可能会导致您的成绩作废！***

-----



## 活动是如何进行的？

在服务器开启时，选择我们的活动服务器，服务器将不会启用碰撞，这也意味着，所有道路规则将不适用。

![](https://s2.imgbb.ws/file/storage-sv2/iBO3T.jpg)
### *您必须从 **慕尼黑** 出发*

当您找到了一个Haulie时，请打开您的TAB，用F12截图 **并展示出自己的卡车**，以证明您找到了它，如果不符合要求将视为无效的提交！



-----



## 奖品！

## - 第一名的个人：75元红包
## - 第二名的个人：50元红包
## - 第三名的个人：25元红包



-----

## Notes: If you are an international player whose native language is not Chinese, then you will not be able to compete for rankings because the form we provide does not have the Chinese communication software and cannot be submitted.

-----



## 提交处：

upcoming.rule:
🚛 Konvoi-Regeln | TruckersMP Event
Um einen reibungslosen Ablauf und maximalen Fahrspaß für alle Beteiligten zu gewährleisten, bitten wir alle Teilnehmer, sich an die folgenden Regeln zu halten:

1. 🚦 Allgemeines & Server-Regeln
TMP-Regeln beachten: Es gelten jederzeit die offiziellen TruckersMP Regeln. Verstöße können zum Ausschluss vom Event oder zu Strafen durch Modder/Admins führen.

Anweisungen befolgen: Den Anweisungen des Event-Teams, der Absicherung (Convois Control / CC) und der Admins ist unverzüglich Folge zu leisten.

2. 🚛 Fahrzeug & Setup
Konvoi-Truck & Skin: Bitte erscheint nach Möglichkeit im vorgegebenen Firmen-Skin bzw. Event-Skin.

Keine Doppeltrailer / Schwerlast: Es sind nur Standard-Trailer (Single Trailer) erlaubt (außer vom Event-Team anders angekündigt).

Fahrzeugzustand: Bitte erscheint mit einem vollständig reparierten und aufgetankten LKW am Treffpunkt.

3. 🛣️ Verhalten auf der Strecke
Sicherheitsabstand: Haltet stets ausreichend Abstand zum Vorderfrau/-mann (mindestens 70 – 100 Meter), um Desync-Unfälle und Kettenreaktionen zu vermeiden.

Geschwindigkeit:

Landstraße: ca. 70 km/h

Autobahn: ca. 90 km/h (oder nach Vorgabe der Konvoileitung)

Überholverbot: Das Überholen innerhalb des Konvois ist strengstens verboten! (Ausnahme: Die Konvoileitung oder Absicherung gibt eine explizite Freigabe).

Spur halten: Fahrt versatzfrei auf eurer Spur. Abruptes Bremsen oder Schlangenlinienfahren ist zu unterlassen.

4. 🚨 Absicherung & Pannen
Warnblinkanlage: Bitte nutzt die Warnblinkanlage nur bei Notfällen, Staus oder am Ende des Konvois.

Unfall / LKW beschädigt:

Solltet ihr einen Unfall haben oder stecken bleiben, setzt euch sofort zurück (F7 / Werkstatt) oder teleportiert euch an das Ende des Konvois.

Blockiert nicht die Strecke!

Rejoin: Wer die Verbindung verliert oder in die Werkstatt muss, reiht sich bitte ganz hinten am Ende des Konvois wieder ein.

5. 🎙️ Discord & Kommunikation
Funk / Sprachkanal: Während der Fahrt bitten wir um Disziplin im Discord. Bitte nutzt Push-to-Talk und haltet den Funk bei wichtigen Durchsagen der Konvoileitung frei.

CB-Funk Ingame: Den vorgegebenen CB-Funkkanal (wird vor Start bekanntgegeben) bitte nur für wichtige Event-Hinweise nutzen.
